To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we propose MICRO-Graph: an effective framework to pre-train GNNs with motifs for downstream chemical property prediction tasks; 2) we design a novel motif discovery strategy to simultaneously cluster similar subgraphs and conduct contrastive learning of subgraph representations; 3) we propose a learnable sampler to generate subgraph samples aligned with motif discovery; 4) the pre-trained GGNs can improve various downstream chemical property prediction with scarce label.

1) MICRO-Graph is the first work to utilize motif discovery for contrastive learning of pre-trained GNNs; 2) our framework can be easily extended for other self-supervised learning tasks; 3) our pre-training strategy can benefit various downstream tasks, and can be applied on other graph datasets.
We propose a motif-driven framework to automatically discover graph motifs and leverage learned motifs to pre-train GNNs with self-supervised learning.
